results.name: Console de jeu / Video-game console
results.description:
Afin de tester Blender sur le modificateur "Boolean", j'ai eût l'idée de modéliser une console de jeu-vidéo.

Genre, une console de jeux-vidéo nommée "Foldeur" exclusivement européenne pouvant accueillir pleins de support (CDs, cartouches, tablettes et toute l'étendue des supports en USB) et ainsi profiter de toute l'étendue du support physique.

Vous pouvez remarquer que sur le devant, il y a 
* La "sensorbar" de la Nintendo Wii et la Nintendo Wii U,
* Les boutons "Power" (avec sa diode verte), le bouton RESET et un bouton configurable dans le BIOS,
* Le support CD,
* 8 ports USB 3.0,
* Le logo "Foldeur" et la mention "European Multi-Support Game System",

Les cotés n'ont que la ventillation

Derrière, il y a
*  L'alimentation a 3 broches,
*  De la ventillation,
*  Une zone d'extension de mémoire interne,
*  Une prise Ethernet (RJ-45),
*  Une prise HDMI,
*  Une prise VGA,
*  5 ports USB 3.0,
*  Le bouton d'alimentation "On/Off".

results.name: Matt Mii Rig
results.description:
Leave a comment below to let me know how you like the rig! The infamouse Matt of Wii Sports fame. Matt Mii is a CPU opponent from Wii Sports, Wii Sports Resort and Wii Party video games for the Wii video game console. In memes, the character is often referred to as the strongest opponent in Wii Sports, with his abilities humorously exaggerated. Modeled and rigged in Maya from scratch. Textures made in Photoshop and Substance Painter. Files included:
  • FBX
  • Maya MB Rig File
  • Head & body color map 1024 x 1024
  • Head & body roughness map 1024 x 1024
While the model is always free to download, a like, commment, and follow would be greatly appreciated.

results.name: Wii
results.description:
This is a highly optimized, stylized model of the classic Nintendo Wii, created as a hobbyist project in Blender. It is designed specifically for game developers who need a retro console asset that won't slow down their performance.
Technical Details:
Software: Modeled and UV-mapped in Blender.
Topology: Pure low-poly geometry, perfect for real-time engines like Godot.
Use Case: Ideal for room dioramas, game console props, or VR environments.

Why I Made This:
I’ve always been a fan of Nintendo hardware, from the Wii to the Switch. This model is a tribute to the console that defined the motion-gaming era. While this version is free for the community, I am currently working on a premium version but don't expect it to be free.

The Legacy of the Wii
The Nintendo Wii remains one of the most iconic pieces of hardware in gaming history. Known for its sleek, vertical design and the introduction of the Wii Remote, it brought gaming to a massive global audience. This model captures that classic "white box" aesthetic.
